usage: agentbreeder registry diff [-h] [--context N] [--json]
                                  [--project PROJECT]
                                  FROM TO

positional arguments:
  FROM               kind/name@X.Y.Z
  TO                 kind/name@X.Y.Z

options:

  --context N        Lines of context (default 3)
  --json
  --project PROJECT
